aiExplanation: This code sorts the array in ascending order, then iterates through consecutive elements to find the **minimum difference** between any two adjacent numbers. It uses `Math.min()` to track the smallest difference encountered, and returns this value or `0` if no difference exists. Note: This solution doesn't use the `k` parameter, so it finds the minimum difference between any consecutive pair rather than among elements `k` positions apart.

aiExplanation: This code sorts the array and uses a sliding window approach to find the **minimum difference** among any `k` elements. It iterates through the array starting at index `k-1`, comparing each element with the element `k-1` positions before it (creating a window of `k` consecutive numbers), and tracks the smallest difference found using `Math.min()`. This efficiently finds the minimum spread across all possible windows of size `k`.
